decisions.reason: A door lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core metal-forming and handle design knowledge, so it can readily interpret early results and refine the family rather than withdraw it after one year.
Mitred handles are a design variant within the firm's established handle competence, and its accumulated know-how lets it assimilate market feedback and keep improving the line.

Although the multifunctional handle stretches into newer functional territory, it still rests on related handle knowledge and in-house development, so a short market presence gives too little reason to drop it.
A single lever handle model sits squarely in the core portfolio, where the firm's existing knowledge allows low-cost upkeep and incremental improvement.
The FSB 1289 collection won the 2023 German Design Award and has its own page, showing strong recognition that the firm can exploit with its deep design and production expertise.
A patinated bronze finish draws on the firm's established surface-treatment and bronze material knowledge and broadens the range across existing models at little cost.
